sample_positive_and_negative_bboxes: sample positive and negative bounding boxes from candidates using assign results and ground truth bboxes
sample_positive_samples: sample positive samples from assigned bounding boxes given expected count and assignment results
sample_negative_samples: sample negative samples from assigned bounding boxes given expected count and assignment results
create_basesampler_subclass: create a subclass of BaseSampler implementing _sample_pos and _sample_neg abstract methods for custom bbox sampling
review_basesampler_sample: review the BaseSampler sample method to understand how positive and negative bbox sampling with GT proposals works
